coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable categories (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity), broadly comparable pretrained/baseline versus feedback-updated model conditions, and structural diversity including carbon-chain features.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed MolGen pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration. Replaces ESR1 and ACAA1 with unrelated proteins and does not vary synthetic versus natural-product domains. Reports aggregate and top-1% docking metrics rather than top-three property scores, and omits the specified binding-affinity improvements. Introduces extensive RL and agentic experiments instead of the specified MOLGEN comparison.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected findings: MOLGEN's high p-logP scores, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% ESR1 and 70.4% ACAA1 improvements, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained diversity.
